meta_title: Why Choose SN Cleaning Services for Upholstery Cleaning
meta_description: Sofa and upholstery cleaning in London and Essex that starts with your fabric: hidden spot test, fabric safe products, price agreed first, 24 hour re clean.
intro: A sofa is often one of the most expensive things in the room, and easily the most used. When it's marked, tired or smells faintly of the dog, it's tempting to scrub it yourself and hope for the best. We'd rather you didn't have to take that risk with something you paid good money for.

understand.heading: Why people put off booking
paragraphs: The worry with upholstery is rarely whether it will come out cleaner. It's whether it will still look like your sofa afterwards. People picture water rings, faded colour or a fabric that feels rough, so they leave it for months while the stain quietly sets in.

Sometimes there's a deadline: family coming to stay, a sofa being sold on, or a furnished rental being handed back with the landlord's armchairs in it. Sometimes it's simply the cushions that the children, the cat and every Friday night takeaway have got to first.

We understand both, and we start every job the same way: by finding out what your fabric can take before we put anything on it. If we think a piece shouldn't be cleaned a certain way, we'll say so, even if it means a smaller job for us.

different.heading: What we do differently, and why it matters to you

items.title: We identify the fabric first
items.text: Different materials need different approaches, so we check yours before choosing a treatment. If a piece is delicate or antique, we'll talk it through with you when you book.

items.title: A test in a hidden spot
items.text: We always test on an area nobody sees before cleaning the whole piece, so colour and texture stay as they should.

items.title: Fabric safe solutions
items.text: Professional products chosen to lift dirt and stains while keeping colours intact, and safe for pets and children.

items.title: Seams, piping and crevices
items.text: We work into the places where crumbs, dust and pet hair hide, not just the flat surfaces you can see from across the room.

items.title: Priced per item
items.text: Upholstery cleaning starts from £69 and is priced per item, so you pay for exactly what you need: a single armchair, one sofa or a whole suite.

items.title: Straight answers about risk
items.text: If a fabric is unusual or a stain may not shift completely, we tell you before we start. If your furniture is leather, mention it when booking and we'll advise on the right approach.

steps.title: Tell us what needs cleaning
steps.text: Add each piece in the booking form, whether that's sofas, armchairs, dining chairs, headboards or curtains, and see the price before you confirm.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: We identify the fabric, do a spot test in a hidden area and pre treat any visible stains.

steps.title: The deep clean
steps.text: A full fabric clean with a fabric safe solution and an odour removal treatment, working carefully into seams, piping and crevices.

steps.title: Finishing
steps.text: We use a fast dry technique, then brush and groom the pile where the fabric has one, so it looks and feels right.

steps.title: Back to normal
steps.text: Most upholstery is dry enough to sit on within a few hours, with full drying usually complete within 24 hours.

promise.heading: Our promise to you
paragraphs: If you're not happy with the clean, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean it free of charge.

Your price is agreed before you book. If a piece turns out to be heavily soiled, or a delicate fabric needs extra care, we'll explain why and confirm any extra cost with you before we start, never afterwards. And the person working on your furniture is always one of our own trained, insured and DBS checked team, never a subcontractor.

proof.heading: Who will be looking after your furniture
proof.paragraph: SN Cleaning Services has been cleaning homes across London and Essex for 12 years and was registered as a company in 2019. We started with regular domestic cleaning, then spent four years when about 95% of our bookings were end of tenancy cleans, and grew from there into deep, heavy duty and Airbnb cleaning. That background means we're used to furnished homes, including landlords' furniture that has to go back in good condition, and we know that with upholstery, care matters as much as effort. Our office is at 15A Shenfield Road, Brentwood.

faqs.question: How much does sofa cleaning cost?
faqs.answer: Upholstery cleaning starts from £69. It's priced per item, so a large sofa costs more than a single armchair. Add each piece in the booking form and you'll see your exact price before you confirm anything.

faqs.question: What types of furniture do you clean?
faqs.answer: Sofas, armchairs, dining chairs, headboards and curtains, as well as most other upholstered furniture. If you have something unusual, such as a delicate or antique piece, tell us when you book and we'll advise on the best approach before anything is agreed.

faqs.question: Can you clean curtains?
faqs.answer: Yes, curtains are among the items we clean. Add them in the booking form and tell us the fabric if you know it, so we can plan the right approach. As with all upholstery, we test on a hidden area before cleaning the whole piece.

faqs.question: Can you remove pet hair and pet smells?
faqs.answer: Every upholstery clean includes an odour removal treatment, and the deep clean lifts dirt and hair embedded in the fabric, including along seams and crevices. Tell us about pet stains or smells when you book so we can pre treat them properly.

faqs.question: Will every stain come out?
faqs.answer: We pre treat visible stains and many lift well, but some, especially older or previously treated ones, may not come out completely. We'll give you an honest view before we start rather than promise something we can't deliver.

faqs.question: Is it safe for my children and pets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our upholstery service uses fabric safe solutions that are safe for pets and children. Keep everyone off the furniture until it's dry enough to sit on, which for most upholstery is within a few hours.

faqs.question: What should I do before you arrive?
faqs.answer: Clear cushions you don't want cleaned, throws, toys and anything else off the furniture, and empty the gaps down the sides if you can. Make sure there's space around each piece so we can reach every side comfortably.

faqs.question: Can you clean a sofa I'm about to sell?
faqs.answer: Yes. A cleaned sofa looks and smells fresher, which helps when you're selling it on. Tell us your deadline when you book so you can allow for drying time, which is usually a few hours to sit on and up to 24 hours fully.

faqs.question: Can you clean the landlord's furniture at the end of my tenancy?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upholstery cleaning is often booked alongside an end of tenancy clean when furnished properties are handed back. Our end of tenancy cleaning starts from £179. Mention both when you get a quote so the visits can be planned together.

faqs.question: What do you use to clean upholstery?
faqs.answer: Professional equipment and fabric safe solutions, chosen once we've identified the fabric. We always test on a hidden area first and only clean the whole piece when we're happy with the result of that test.

faqs.question: Can you clean a fabric headboard?
faqs.answer: Yes, headboards are one of the items we clean. Add yours in the booking form. If the mattress on that bed needs attention too, our mattress cleaning starts from £39 and can be done on the same visit.

faqs.question: Do you clean sofa beds?
faqs.answer: Yes, a sofa bed is upholstered furniture like any other sofa. Tell us it's a sofa bed when you book, and if the mattress inside needs cleaning as well, mention it so we can include it in your quote.

faqs.question: Do I need to be at home?
faqs.answer: Tell us how we'll get in when you book. Many people like to be at home to point out the pieces and any marks that bother them most, but clear access notes work too. Our team will confirm the arrangements with you.

faqs.question: How long does the clean take?
faqs.answer: It depends on how many pieces you book and their condition. A single armchair takes far less time than a full suite. Tell us what you need when you get a quote, and our team can give you an idea of timing.

faqs.question: Are the people cleaning my furniture insured and vetted?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every job is done by our own trained, insured and DBS checked team, never subcontractors. You'll always know the person in your home works with SN Cleaning Services and that we stand behind their work.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the result?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean it free of charge. If it's a mark we warned you might not lift fully, we'll be straight with you about whether anything more can realistically be done.

faqs.question: Will there be extra charges on the day?
faqs.answer: Your price is agreed before we start. If a piece turns out to be heavily soiled, or a delicate fabric needs extra care, we'll explain why and confirm any additional cost with you before doing the work, so you're never surprised.

faqs.question: Can you clean upholstery, carpets and mattresses in one visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Carpet cleaning starts from £49 per room and mattress cleaning from £39. Mention everything when you get your quote and we can look at combining carpets, upholstery and mattresses into a single visit.

faqs.question: How often should a sofa be cleaned?
faqs.answer: There's no fixed rule. Homes with pets, young children or a sofa that's used every evening tend to need it more often than a rarely used guest room chair. If you're not sure whether yours is due, tell us about it and we'll give you an honest view.

faqs.question: Can you deal with smells such as food or smoke?
faqs.answer: Our deep clean includes an odour removal treatment that works on the fabric itself rather than masking the smell with fragrance. Tell us what kind of smell it is when you book so we can let you know honestly what to expect.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: The booking form shows your full price and how payment works before you confirm. If you have any question about paying, our support team can help Monday to Friday 7am to 10pm and Saturday and Sunday 8am to 5pm.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Please contact our team, who will explain how changes and cancellations work for your booking. The sooner you let us know, the easier it is to help, and our support team is available seven days a week during opening hours.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We clean upholstery across London and Essex from our office in Brentwood. Click Get a quote and enter your postcode, and the form will confirm whether we cover your address.

cta.text: Add your pieces in the booking form and see the exact price before you decide.

notes: Facts I wanted but did not have: an upholstery related Google review (I used two general ones), whether leather can be cleaned at all, cancellation policy, payment method and typical time per item. The service page says heavily soiled or delicate pieces 'may carry a small additional charge'; I said any extra cost is confirmed before work starts, without giving amounts. No before and after photos promised for upholstery, as the brief limits photos to end of tenancy, deep, after builders and carpet.
